title: FBI Photo B9
doc_notes: This document is an FBI report submitted to AARO regarding a single UAP still image derived from U.S. military sensor data.

incidents.summary: A grainy monochrome image showing a small dark circular object against an indistinct mountain range background, captured by a U.S. military system.
incidents.quote: A small, dark, circular object is visible just below and to the left of the center of the reticle.
